metric_note: micro_accuracy -- subset-weighted version of the official MMMU-Pro micro accuracy (sum(w*if_right)/sum(w)). Evaluation is served by the standalone repo-root script mmmu_pro.py (run/eval --subset small|tiny), which scores with the official MMMU repo evaluate.py; the VLMEvalKit in-tree MMMU_Pro pipeline is guarded off
weighting: score = sum(w_i * s_i) / sum(w_i); weights normalised so sum(w_i) == 1
